title: Lecture 10 — objects, methods, and events
summary: Trace receivers, shared state and callbacks through an object-oriented event-driven program.
body:
Authored study companion based on the published lecture slides, checked 17 November. Work through the topic below, then attempt its self-check before opening the solution.

Bundle state with methods, understand self, and distinguish immutable updates from mutable event handlers.

Read the linked original slides for Pyking syntax and language comparisons.
